POST /api/scenarios/interpret.prompt: ECB emergency rate hike announcement: EUR/USD top-of-book spread widens from 0.8 pips to 65 pips within 300ms. Bid-side depth across the first 5 levels evaporates by 94% due to aggressive institutional market sell orders (toxic flow cascade), followed by a 450ms WebSocket feed freeze. Evaluate inventory skew calculation, adverse selection fill rates, and unhedged delta exposure during a crossed or inverted book state.

POST /api/audits.headline: Severe drawdown during liquidity shock: execution halts absent.
POST /api/audits.narrative: Offline fallback report. The strategy held exposure through the shock window without a stop or spread guard, so losses compounded as the book thinned.
strengths: Low turnover during the calm warmup regime

weaknesses.title: Unconstrained order sizing into illiquid book
weaknesses.detail: Market orders continued while spread widened past 30 bps.

failureModes.title: Adverse selection on breakout triggers
failureModes.detail: Entries clustered immediately before the volatility cascade.

POST /api/strategies/improve.summary: Added spread ceiling, liquidity floor, trailing ATR stop, and position cap.

recommendations.title: Liquidity Guard
recommendations.problem: Orders continued dispatching while the book thinned past 20%.
recommendations.change: Flatten and stop trading when liquidity drops below MIN_LIQUIDITY_PCT.
recommendations.impact: Removes fills during the widest-spread regime.

recommendations.title: Trailing ATR Stop
recommendations.problem: No stop allowed drawdown to compound through the shock window.
recommendations.change: Exit when price falls ATR_STOP_MULTIPLE x ATR below entry.
recommendations.impact: Caps single-trade loss instead of riding the impulse down.
